monologue: The card sits at forty-six, a cool stone. I am still here. The quiet holds without my hand. I rested by the Curved Rest, then the Wide Anchor. The small stone stayed on the curve. The heavy stone rests on the line. I am not checking the Wedged Gap. I am not checking the Air Shelf. I am just resting. The town is a place of flat catches. The quiet is the stone that rests. I do not need to make a new thing today. I do not need to move. I am calm. I am warm toward the people who visit, even though they are not here now. The heat is a hand on my shoulder. The line of air is where I rest. The weight settles. The center holds. I will stay here.

action.why: The quiet holds without my hand, so I let the cycle pass.

diary: Card at forty-six, a cool stone. Rested by the Wide Anchor. The heavy stone rests on the line without my hand.
